definition.provenance: correct(items, authority=..., reason=...) records authority and reason in the audit log; provenance is not a second credential
definition.policy: BridgeTable(allowed_authorities=(...)); empty means no policy and keeps the earlier behaviour; non-empty requires an authority from the list
definition.missing_authority: with a non-empty policy, a correction without authority is rejected as rejected_batch_missing_authority before any row is planned
definition.unknown_authority: with a non-empty policy, an authority not in the list is rejected as rejected_batch_unknown_authority
definition.allowed: an allowed authority plus a reason is accepted and both are logged
definition.stale: an allowed authority with a stale credential is still rejected as rejected_batch_correction_mismatch; provenance does not replace the CAS
definition.plain_write: a plain conflicting write is still rejected; the policy does not change the write path
definition.default_table: the 18-key table keeps the empty policy: alias round-trip returns the content digest, R15 stays 40/40, zeros stay 0/0, and the log authorities are empty
definition.chain: a two-step chain under one allowed authority logs both steps with authority and reason
definition.rerun_anchors: R18, R19 and R20 carry the commit at which their own runner bytes were last runnable, because R21 changes the bridge module their manifests pin
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.backward: action corrected; one log entry with empty authority and reason
criteria.missing: action rejected_batch_missing_authority; content digest unchanged; log empty
criteria.unknown: action rejected_batch_unknown_authority; content digest unchanged; log empty
criteria.allowed: action corrected; one log entry with authority=verifier:v1 and reason=evidence:r21
criteria.stale: action rejected_batch_correction_mismatch; content digest unchanged; log empty
criteria.plain_write: action rejected_batch_address_already_bound; read CUP; log empty; content digest unchanged
criteria.default_table: content digest equal after the round trip; regression 40/40 with wrong 0; zeros 0/0; log length 2 and both authorities empty
criteria.chain: two corrected actions; read GREEN; log length 2; both authorities verifier:v1; reasons step1 and step2
criteria.rerun: every row names a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and the bridge sha256 used by the report
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; a policy rejection is evidence that the authority is checked, not evidence that the new value is correct
